title: Pfam/InterPro protein domain track pack (hg38)
context: Pfam and InterPro provide protein domain annotations under CC0, enabling researchers to see which parts of a gene encode known protein domains. In cancer genomics, this is useful for understanding whether a variant falls in a functionally important domain (e.g. a kinase domain or DNA-binding domain) — providing research context without making clinical claims. This source-catalog entry aligns with the backlog domains-026 task; the gate must be run and a committed artifact produced before the pack is built.
objective: Apply the licensegate-002 gate to Pfam/InterPro (CC0), produce a committed PASS artifact, and deliver a protein domain coordinate track on hg38 mapped to gene coordinates, with per-feature provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Pfam/InterPro (CC0); licensegate-002 PASS artifact committed with permitsRedistribution: true and nonCommercial: false.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact committed for hg38; protein domain coordinates mapped to genomic coordinates on hg38 and recorded.
All three browser targets emitted and render-verified; protein domain features appear at expected gene-coordinate loci on hg38 with evidence in outcomes/ds-pfam-008.json.
Per-feature provenance records Pfam/InterPro domain accessions, source release version, and CC0 license; provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100.
Pack carries not-medical-advice notice; hosted at a loadable URL; adoption evidence or blocker recorded.
output: output/packs/pfam-domains-hg38/ — BED/bigBed track files, browser configs, gate artifacts, manifest, and outcomes/ds-pfam-008.json.
